Map-based survey and distance/area measurement app. Use GPS, markers, notes, and export survey results to CSV / JSON / KML.
• Map types: Normal / Satellite / Terrain / Hybrid
• Units: m, km, mi, ft, nmi, yd
Offline survey • GPS • Map measurement • Export
Data is stored locally on your device (Room + DataStore). No account or cloud sync.
MPorT Maps respects your privacy. This app is designed to work locally on your device without sending personal data to our servers.
• GPS location: used only when you request a GPS point or enable My Location on the map. Location is not sent to third-party servers by this app (except via Google Maps SDK subject to Google policy).
• Surveys, markers, and notes: stored in a local database (Room) on your device. No automatic cloud backup.
• Settings (units, map type, theme, language): stored in local DataStore.
• ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION — to show position and add points from GPS.\n• INTERNET — to load Google Maps tiles (if API key is available).
We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data. Export files (CSV/JSON/KML) are created only on your request and saved to storage you choose.
Maps are provided by Google Maps SDK. Use of Google services is subject to Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
This app is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from children.
We may update this policy. The latest version will be shown on this page.
For privacy questions, contact the MPorT Maps developer.

MPorT Maps is designed with privacy and local-first security in mind. Below is how your data and the app are protected.
Surveys, markers, notes, and settings are stored only on your device using Android Room database and DataStore. There is no cloud account and no automatic upload of your survey data to our servers.

Location is accessed only when you grant permission and when you use GPS or My Location features. The app does not track your location in the background for advertising or analytics beyond what Google Maps SDK may do under Google policies.
Internet is used primarily to load Google Maps tiles (when an API key is configured). Export files are written to device storage you choose; they are not sent to external servers by the app itself.
• Location (fine/coarse): required for GPS points and map position.\n• Internet: required for map tiles.\nNo contacts, camera, microphone, or SMS permissions are requested.
CSV, JSON, and KML exports are created only when you request them and are saved under your control (e.g. Downloads). Treat exported files according to your own data policy.
Install the app only from trusted sources. Keep your device OS and the app updated. Do not install modified or unofficial builds.
If you discover a security concern, please contact the MPorT Maps developer with details so it can be investigated.

Google Maps requires an API key. Without a key, the screen may be empty or beige.

Quick setup:
1. Open Google Cloud Console → Maps SDK for Android
2. Create an API key, restrict to package id.mport.maps
3. Set in gradle.properties:
 MAPS_API_KEY=AIza…
4. Rebuild the app (Sync + Run)
